description: Plain-language definition of an accounting, tax, or compliance term (e.g. "accrual", "GSTR-3B", "input tax credit", "P&L", "reconciliation", "BAS", "1099"). Resolves by exact name, alias, or fuzzy match against a curated glossary scoped to bookkeeping plus the IN/UK/AU/US/CA regimes HelloBooks serves; returns the definition, related terms, or the closest suggestions. Definitions are general guidance — confirm specifics against the relevant authority.

term.description: The accounting/tax term to define, e.g. "accrual", "GSTR-3B", "input tax credit", "P&L".
